ShortDescription.Value: Parks and Road Repairs, and adjust all Road wear damage rates.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Parks and Road Repairs
Everything is OPTIONAL - you choose!
- Parks/Roads Maintenance
- **Parks + Roads Repairs**: fleet size, work shift + rate - Road wear (beta): scale speed roads accumulate damage over time
- *Adjust Sliders* at any time, no restart needed; supports switching cities. - No Harmony or Reflection used; more compatible - less likely to break on patch days. - Safe to remove any time (use Reset buttons to return to vanilla game default values).
### Support and feedback - If the mod helps you, give it a Like, it's free + easy :)
- Feedback on: Github, Discord links on the right.
### Credits - River-Mochi: author - yenyang: code review and testing. - Necko1996: testing
### 11 Languages
- English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Polski Polish, Português Brazilian - 한국어, 日本語, 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese), 繁體中文 Traditional Chinese
